comment_dependencies: react-dom 19 declares scheduler as a peer dep, but bun (≥1.3) does not auto-install peer deps the way npm/pnpm do. Without an explicit dependency here, esbuild fails resolving 'scheduler' from inside react-dom-client.development.js on Windows + bun (Windows GAP-13). Pinning it at the workspace root hoists it where every consumer can find it.
comment_forgeax_deps: The root workspace owns integration contracts and small tooling packages only. Product runtime packages are independently installed and validated by forgeax-ide or their owning repository.
comment_engine_runtime_deps: The play-runtime preview (packages/editor/packages/play-runtime) sets resolve.preserveSymlinks:true and consumes the @forgeax/engine-* packages through Windows JUNCTIONS into the nested engine submodule (packages/editor/packages/engine/packages/*). Bun's isolated linker places each engine package's third-party deps as RELATIVE symlinks (..\..\..×7\node_modules\.bun\<pkg>) pointing back at THIS root's store. When Vite resolves those third-party imports through the junction WITHOUT realpath (preserveSymlinks), the relative '..' hops are computed from the junction's apparent play-runtime path, not the real engine path, so the symlink dangles and Rollup/esbuild reports 'Failed to resolve import' (Windows-only 打包/导包 failure). Pinning each browser-runtime engine dep here makes bun create an ABSOLUTE-target top-level junction (same fix as 'scheduler' above) that the play-runtime node_modules walk-up finds after skipping the dangling nested link. Node/build-only engine deps (ws, fast-glob, pngjs, @zappar/msdf-generator) resolve in the Vite/Node process normally and are intentionally NOT pinned.
comment_dsh_peer_deps: @forgeax/engine-intelligence-dsh consumes @deepseek-ai/dsh-sdk-client, whose runtime contract is expressed as a transitive peer graph. Bun 1.3 writes an unreadable lockfile when those peers are only reachable through the nested Engine workspace. Hoist and pin the complete rc.6 peer family at the Studio workspace root so fresh and frozen installs resolve the same graph.
